A new strategy must use communications, messaging, and signals with opponents, allies, and publics. This does not mean that every action should be accompanied by a press release, but a new cyber strategy will need to use public and private communications to shape opinion in ways favorable to the United States and make it clear that our actions are guided by international law and agreement.
